---
title: "Violin and half (split) violin plots in JavaScript with CanvasXpress"
description: "Show a full distribution per group as a violin, then split it in half to compare two conditions side by side — interactive and reproducible, in the browser."
author: "Isaac Neuhaus"
date: "2026-09-27"
categories: [JavaScript, CanvasXpress, violin, visualization]
image: "thumbnail.png"
---

A violin plot shows the **full shape of a distribution** instead of collapsing it to a box's
quartiles. And a **split (half) violin** puts one condition on each half so you can compare two
groups at the same position. CanvasXpress is a JavaScript library at heart, so in the browser it's
just a `data` object and a `config`.

## Load the library

```html
<link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/neuhausi/canvasXpress@69.6.1/inst/htmlwidgets/lib/canvasXpress/canvasXpress.css" rel="stylesheet">
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/neuhausi/canvasXpress@69.6.1/inst/htmlwidgets/lib/canvasXpress/canvasXpress.min.js"></script>
```

## The markup and the spec

A violin is a `Boxplot` graph with the violin turned on. One measured variable (`value`) × N
observations, with the grouping columns as sample annotations (`x`). For the split violin, group by
both factors, colour by condition, and set `violinSide: "split"`.

```html
<canvas id="violin" width="650" height="500"></canvas>
<canvas id="violinSplit" width="650" height="500"></canvas>
<script>
  // standard normal via Box–Muller
  function gauss() {
    var u = 0, v = 0;
    while (u === 0) u = Math.random();
    while (v === 0) v = Math.random();
    return Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(u)) * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * v);
  }

  var doses = ["Low", "Medium", "High"], conds = ["Control", "Treated"];
  var mus = { Low: 6, Medium: 8, High: 10 };
  var value = [], Dose = [], Condition = [];
  doses.forEach(function (d) {
    conds.forEach(function (co) {
      var mu = mus[d] + (co === "Treated" ? 1.5 : 0);
      for (var i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
        value.push(Math.round((mu + 1.2 * gauss()) * 100) / 100);
        Dose.push(d); Condition.push(co);
      }
    });
  });
  var ids = value.map(function (_, i) { return "o" + (i + 1); });

  var data = { y: { vars: ["value"], smps: ids, data: [value] },
               x: { Dose: Dose, Condition: Condition } };

  // full violin
  new CanvasXpress("violin", data, {
    graphType: "Boxplot", showViolinBoxplot: true, violinScale: "area",
    groupingFactors: ["Dose"], xAxis: ["value"], smpTitle: "Dose",
    title: "Distribution of value by dose"
  });

  // split (half) violin comparing conditions
  new CanvasXpress("violinSplit", data, {
    graphType: "Boxplot", showViolinBoxplot: true, violinScale: "area",
    groupingFactors: ["Dose", "Condition"], colorBy: "Condition",
    violinSide: "split", violinTrim: false, xAxis: ["value"], smpTitle: "Dose",
    title: "Control vs Treated — split violin by dose"
  });
</script>
```

## Live result

```{=html}
<link href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/neuhausi/canvasXpress@69.6.1/inst/htmlwidgets/lib/canvasXpress/canvasXpress.css" rel="stylesheet">
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/neuhausi/canvasXpress@69.6.1/inst/htmlwidgets/lib/canvasXpress/canvasXpress.min.js"></script>
<canvas id="violinLive" width="650" height="500"></canvas>
<canvas id="violinSplitLive" width="650" height="500"></canvas>
<script>
(function () {
  function gauss() {
    var u = 0, v = 0;
    while (u === 0) u = Math.random();
    while (v === 0) v = Math.random();
    return Math.sqrt(-2 * Math.log(u)) * Math.cos(2 * Math.PI * v);
  }
  function draw() {
    if (typeof CanvasXpress === "undefined") { return setTimeout(draw, 60); }
    var doses = ["Low", "Medium", "High"], conds = ["Control", "Treated"];
    var mus = { Low: 6, Medium: 8, High: 10 };
    var value = [], Dose = [], Condition = [];
    doses.forEach(function (d) {
      conds.forEach(function (co) {
        var mu = mus[d] + (co === "Treated" ? 1.5 : 0);
        for (var i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
          value.push(Math.round((mu + 1.2 * gauss()) * 100) / 100);
          Dose.push(d); Condition.push(co);
        }
      });
    });
    var ids = value.map(function (_, i) { return "o" + (i + 1); });
    var data = { y: { vars: ["value"], smps: ids, data: [value] },
                 x: { Dose: Dose, Condition: Condition } };
    new CanvasXpress("violinLive", data, {
      graphType: "Boxplot", showViolinBoxplot: true, violinScale: "area",
      groupingFactors: ["Dose"], xAxis: ["value"], smpTitle: "Dose",
      title: "Distribution of value by dose" });
    new CanvasXpress("violinSplitLive", data, {
      graphType: "Boxplot", showViolinBoxplot: true, violinScale: "area",
      groupingFactors: ["Dose", "Condition"], colorBy: "Condition",
      violinSide: "split", violinTrim: false, xAxis: ["value"], smpTitle: "Dose",
      title: "Control vs Treated — split violin by dose" });
  }
  draw();
})();
</script>
```

Hover to read the density and summary stats. `violinSide` can also be `"lt"` or `"rb"` for a
one-sided half violin.

## Why "reproducible"

The `data`+`config` **is** the figure — one portable JSON spec that renders the same from R, Python,
or a web page.
